title: Weight handoff validator and version publish coordinator
creator: Aisha Patel
description: End-to-end coordinator for taking community weights -> deterministic conversion -> validation -> publish a catalog entry with pinned runtime version and performance profile. This ticket wires up the weight-handoff validator service, implements a reproducible smoke-and-profile stage, and adds the final publish step that atomically pins a model version to a runtime artifact and performance profile. Goal: reduce manual steps and flakiness when onboarding new OSS LLMs so that an engineer can submit weights and see a verified 'published' model entry within a single orchestrated flow.
summary: Implement orchestration, validation, and publishing path so new open-source model weights are reliably converted, validated, profiled, and pinned to a runtime artifact and catalog entry.
acceptance_criteria: Weights can be submitted via ingest API and land in artifacts-bucket /incoming with metadata parsed
Automated converter runs (supports PyTorch -> gguf / safetensors) and produces deterministic binaries with checksum
Validation stages: signature/license sniff, shape/metadata checks, smoke generation (10 prompts) succeed within latency budget
Profiling job runs and emits performance profile JSON with throughput and median p95 latency for typical sequences
Atomic publish marks a catalog entry with: pinned runtime tag, artifact checksum, profile id, and a release note
Audit log entry created with KMS-encrypted key for provenance and a link to PR/Confluence notes
Manual abort and retry path available; failures send annotated alerts to #ingest and create a Linear sub-issue
tasks: Add 'weights-handoff-validator' service to ingest orchestration (k8s job spec + helm chart)
Hook converter microservice into orchestrator; support existing convertors and a fallback converter
Implement deterministic binary validation (size, dtype, param checksum) and manifest generation
Wire profiling runner to use same seed prompts and KV cache warmups; produce performance profile schema v2
Publish step: write catalog entry via model-catalog API and pin runtime artifact; create release note template
Integrate audit logging (kms-wrapped keys) and attach to publish transaction
Create smoke test suite for common failure modes (license mismatch, missing tokenizer, NaN params)
decisions: Use gguf as canonical runtime artifact format for published models to simplify runtime selection
Adopt profile schema v2 (adds median p95 and quantization buckets) for catalog compatibility
Require human approval only for models with non-permissive licenses or flagged safety heuristics
Order of operations: convert -> deterministic-validate -> smoke-run -> profile -> publish (atomic commit)
blockers: Pending security review for automated license resolution logic (legal sign-off required)
Converter edge-case for fused kernels in upstream weights causing dtype mismatches (ENG-50210)
Need final schema alignment with catalog team for profile v2 (dependency ENG-49812)
